core_philosophy: Balanced core portfolio combining broad U.S. and international equity with dividend quality and Treasury safety. Designed as the primary taxable investment vehicle with a simple, low-maintenance structure.
behavioral_commitment: Simplicity is the edge. Four holdings, clear roles, minimal tinkering. Rebalance on schedule, reinvest dividends, and let compounding work.

intentional_overlap.SCHD_and_VTI: SCHD overlaps with VTI in large-cap U.S. dividend payers. Intentional to overweight quality dividend income within the broad U.S. equity allocation.
intentional_overlap.VTI_and_VXUS: Together VTI and VXUS approximate a global equity portfolio with a deliberate U.S. overweight.

target_allocation.name: iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF
target_allocation.role: Ultra-short Treasury — capital preservation and liquidity

notes: Taxable account — prioritize tax-efficient funds and harvest losses at review.
VTI and VXUS are highly tax-efficient broad market ETFs.
SCHD qualified dividends receive favorable tax treatment.
SGOV state-tax-exempt Treasury income; adjust allocation based on liquidity needs.
Four-fund simplicity is a feature, not a limitation.
